job_title: AI & Data Portfolio and Transformation Lead
role_summary: Senior leadership role responsible for orchestrating Manulife Hong Kong's enterprise-scale AI & Data agenda. Owns strategy and roadmap development, portfolio prioritization, transformation operating rhythm, value realization tracking, and executive communications across Enterprise Data Products, AI Platform, AI Adoption, AI Champions, and strategic partnerships. Does not own technical data/AI platform controls or day-to-day delivery.
must_have_requirements: 10+ years experience in strategy, transformation, consulting, portfolio management, or enterprise program leadership
Experience managing a portfolio of initiatives with prioritization, funding, dependency and risk tracking
Proven ability to develop executive proposals, business cases and decision materials for senior leadership
Experience establishing or running a transformation operating cadence (dashboards, steering committees, decision forums)
Strong executive communication skills including materials for CEO/SMT/Board-level audiences
Experience translating ambiguous business needs into structured plans, roadmaps and prioritized initiatives
Cross-functional stakeholder management across business, technology, risk, finance and regional teams
Experience with benefits realization, KPI frameworks or value/adoption tracking for transformation initiatives
Exposure to AI, data or digital transformation programs (strategy/portfolio level, not necessarily technical)
nice_to_have_requirements: Financial services or insurance industry experience
Experience with AI platform, data platform, or enterprise data product initiatives at a strategic level
Experience with change management, adoption programs or AI literacy/champion initiatives
Experience working with regional/global stakeholders in a matrixed multinational organization
Familiarity with operating model design or evolution
Experience supporting regulator or strategic partner discussions
soft_skills_priority: Stakeholder influence and alignment across functions
Facilitation of trade-off and prioritization discussions
Political savvy and diplomacy with senior leadership

scoring_criteria.name: Strategy & Roadmap Development
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core responsibility to develop and maintain the AI & Data strategy, translating business priorities into initiatives and sequencing.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May lack AI-specific strategy experience if background is general transformation

scoring_criteria.name: Portfolio Prioritization & Investment Governance
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Central to the role: maintaining consolidated portfolio view, prioritization criteria, and trade-off facilitation.

scoring_criteria.name: Executive Communication & Decision Materials
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role requires producing high-quality proposals, business cases and narratives for CEO/SMT/Board/regulator audiences.

scoring_criteria.name: Transformation Operating Rhythm & Governance Cadence
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must establish and run recurring governance forums, dashboards and escalation processes.

scoring_criteria.name: Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must work across business, technology, risk, finance and regional teams without direct authority.

scoring_criteria.name: Value Realization & KPI/Adoption Tracking
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Responsible for benefits realization frameworks, adoption tracking, and business outcome measurement.

scoring_criteria.name: AI & Data Domain Exposure
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: While not a technical role, familiarity with AI/data initiatives, platforms and terminology is important for credibility.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates from generic transformation background may have limited direct AI/data exposure

scoring_criteria.name: Financial Services Industry Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Preferred but not mandatory; helps navigate regulatory and industry-specific stakeholder dynamics.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May come from consulting or other industries

scoring_criteria.name: Change Management & Adoption Engagement
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Supports AI Champions, literacy programs and adoption-focused communications.

scoring_criteria.name: Structured Problem Solving & Ambiguity Navigation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must translate ambiguous business needs into clear, actionable plans.

summary_focus: Position as a strategic portfolio/transformation leader, not a technical AI/data practitioner
Emphasize executive engagement, governance cadence design, and portfolio prioritization achievements
Highlight cross-functional orchestration across business, tech, risk, finance stakeholders
Quantify value realization, adoption or benefit tracking outcomes where possible
Reference any AI, data, or digital transformation program involvement even if at strategic/governance level
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim ownership of AI platform technical architecture, model lifecycle or observability
Do not claim ownership of data governance controls or data architecture standards
Do not overstate hands-on data science or engineering delivery experience
Avoid implying day-to-day project management if background is strategic/portfolio-level only

cover_letter_guidance.tone: Executive, confident, consultative — reflecting seniority and cross-functional influence
cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Frame candidate as a bridge-builder who turns fragmented AI/Data initiatives into a coherent, governed enterprise portfolio with clear executive visibility and measurable value
bridge_gaps_honestly: If limited direct AI/Data domain experience, emphasize transferable portfolio governance and transformation orchestration skills applied to complex, technology-driven agendas
If no financial services background, highlight regulatory-adjacent or highly governed industry experience
If no formal AI Champion/literacy program experience, connect to broader change management or capability-building initiatives
